services.value: Provides TCEQ NELAC certified testing for drinking water, non-potable water, soil, and hazardous waste, including underground storage tanks (UST), petroleum storage tanks (PST), hazardous waste characterization & landfill disposal, and drinking water/well water/groundwater/stormwater/NPDES/TPDES/industrial reclaimed water and related programs. Runs tests such as Total Coliform, E. coli, Total Petroleum Hydrocarbons, Volatile Organics by GC/MS, BTEX/MTBE by GC/MS, PAHs by GC/MS, TCLP & SPLP Analysis, and multiple metals by methods including EPA 6010/200.7/7470/7471/245.1 and related listed parameters.
